blurb: Carlton Oaks Golf Club features an 18-hole championship Dye-designed golf course with six sets of tees ranging from 5,039 to 7,410 yards. The course includes a chipping green, putting green, and all grass driving range with private instructional areas. The lodge offers accommodations with amenities such as pool access, internet, and free parking.
extraNote: 48-hour notice is required to cancel reservations.
